title: eo collections --json — catalogue collections
description: Emitted by `eo collections --json` (src/eosdk/cli/commands/collections.py) as a JSON ARRAY. Each element is Collection.model_dump(mode="json") (src/eosdk/models.py::Collection). `id` is the value `eo queryables <id>` and `eo search --collection <id>` accept for the same --protocol; it is backend-native, so the STAC and OData ids for one physical collection may differ. Hand-written on purpose: it is a contract, not a projection of the model. `additionalProperties` is true on the collection object — downstream consumers must tolerate fields added later.

id.description: Backend-native collection identifier, usable as `--collection` for the same protocol.

title.description: Human-readable name; null when the backend does not say.

description.description: Longer prose description; null when the backend does not say.

extent_spatial.description: Spatial extents as bounding boxes. The first entry is the overall extent (STAC convention); further entries, when present, describe sub-regions.

extent_temporal.description: Temporal extents as [start, end] pairs, RFC 3339. Either bound may be null, meaning open-ended.

raw.description: The untouched backend document the collection was normalized from. Backend-specific by design.
